question: Which materials for ritual vessels are enumerated in response to the goddess?
premises: Vessels made of clay are mentioned.
Vessels of tortoise origin and bell-metal are mentioned.
Vessels made of copper metal are mentioned.
inference: Acceptable vessels include those made of clay, tortoise-derived material, bell-metal, and copper.
uncertainties: The exact meaning of kūrmajaṃ as a vessel material is context-dependent.
plain_english: O goddess, vessels may be made of clay, born of the tortoise, made of bell-metal, or made of copper.
